title: Tensor comparison for a prescribed scalar-derived pair
statement: For a ringed site and simultaneous closed tensor models M, every prescribed normalized scalar-derived pair s for a coefficient map a admits a strong tensor comparison. Its ordinary comparison has the scalar-unit pure-tensor formula, and its derived comparison has the all-K-flat counit square, using precisely s.extension, s.derived and s.counit.

source.place: Tags 07A4, 07A6 and 0D6D; specialization of a simultaneous scalar family at one prescribed pair.

proof.text: Update the simultaneous scalar family M.scalar at the single dependent index consisting of the source ring, target ring and coefficient map a. Keep every closed structure and tensor model unchanged. Function.update at its own index is the prescribed pair s.

Apply scalarHomTensorComparison_exists to this updated family, and rewrite its scalar pair at a to s. Its K-flat preservation, chain comparison, pure-tensor equation, derived comparison and normalized representative square are exactly the required fields.

The ordinary-unit field identifies pairUnit with the transported sheafified insertion of 1 tensor x. Given two chain comparisons with the same pure-unit formula, transpose through the ordinary scalar adjunction and apply total pure-tensor extensionality in each degree; this proves uniqueness of the prescribed chain comparison.
